title: PYTHIA, a transferable machine learning framework for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31539v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning has permeated material optimization, providing high value. Nevertheless, its re- liance on a high number of samples limits its applicability to relatively explored material families. In this paper we extend the applicability of machine learning to novel and understudied materials through the PYTHIA (Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture) framework. Pythia utilizes two of the most powerful machine learning concepts, foundational models and transfer learning. We employ a complex foundational model trained on a large dataset of chemically similar molecules, on a target that is physically close to our prediction target. Then, we freeze the weights and perform subspace alignment with the use of a transformer layer and add uncertainty quantification with gaussian processes. translated_title: PYTHIA：一种用于缺陷与吸附位点同步优化的可迁移机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习已经深入材料优化领域，并带来了极高的价值。然而，它对大量样本的依赖限制了其在相对已被充分研究的材料族中的应用。在本文中，我们通过PYTHIA（Probabilistic Yet Transferable Hierarchical Interaction Architecture，概率性可迁移分层交互架构）框架，将机器学习的适用范围扩展到新颖且研究不足的材料。PYTHIA利用了两个最强大的机器学习概念：基础模型和迁移学习。我们采用一个在大型化学相似分子数据集上训练的复杂基础模型，其训练目标在物理上与我们的预测目标相近。随后，我们冻结该模型的权重，借助一个transformer层进行子空间对齐，并通过高斯过程引入不确定性量化。这两个附加层仅需在有限的数据集上进行训练，却能让我们充分利用基础模型所积累的知识，将其迁移到所研究的材料体系中。
tldr: 本文提出PYTHIA框架，通过结合基础模型、迁移学习（子空间对齐）与高斯过程不确定性量化，仅需少量目标数据即可将机器学习迁移应用于新颖且研究不足的材料，实现缺陷与吸附位点的同步优化。
en_tdlr: The PYTHIA framework combines foundation models, transfer learning via subspace alignment, and Gaussian process uncertainty quantification, enabling machine learning to be applied to novel and understudied materials with only limited target data for simultaneous defect and adsorption site optimization.
